official_pairings.description: Prime Hermann supplements Zhuge Liang's lack of March Speed bonuses. In addition, his Alpha Wolf and Poison effects greatly boost the damage of Burning of Xinye and Marquis Zhongwu.
Philip II's Vergina Sun skill already makes him a great fit with most commanders, and the damage reduction from his Macedonian Phalanx greatly improves Zhuge Liang's survivability.

Zhuge Liang and Yi Seong-Gye can deal a ton of AoE skill damage, but do be aware that neither have any March Speed buffs. Positioning and timing will be key if you want to get the most use out of them.

Ashurbanipal's Hawk-Eyed more than makes up for Zhuge Liang's lack of March Speed buffs. Combine the duo with Wedge formation to enhance the AoE skill damage of From the Nile to the Tigris, Burning of Xinye, and Marquis Zhongwu.
Zhuge Liang's Chu Shi Biao helps his troop maintain a healthy supply of Rage, fueling the constant Rage expenditure of Qin Shi Huang's Iron Pierces Bronze and Seal Governs All.

skills.name: Standing Army
skills.effect: This commander's infantry units gain 10% Attack and 20% Health. Whenever their troop deals direct damage, it has a 100% chance to inflict Awed on every troop hit by the skill damage: The targets take 3% more skill damage for 10 seconds. The Awed effect can stack up to 10 times, and its duration resets whenever it gains another stack.

skills.name: Conqueror of Sumer
skills.effect: This commander's infantry units gain 15% March Speed. Infantry units in their troop also deal 10% more damage when attacking another troop on the map. Whenever their troop launches a basic attack, it has a 10% chance to gain a 30% bonus to damage dealt for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

skills.name: Anu's Fury
skills.effect: If this commander's troop is on the map: - Infantry units in their troop gain 10% Defense. - Whenever a target troop reaches 10 stacks of the Awed effect, the effect is dispelled and the target takes direct damage (Damage Factor 1000). In addition, this commander's troop gains a damage-absorbing shield for 5 seconds (Damage Factor 300).

skills.name: Enlil's Blessings
skills.effect: This commander's troop takes 15% less skill damage. Whenever their troop is hit with a basic attack, it has a 50% chance to inflict 2 stacks of Awed on the attacker. If this skill is triggered while this commander's troop has a shield, it will inflict an extra 1 stacks of Awed. Cooldown: 8 seconds.

skills.effect: This commander's troop deals 20% more counterattack damage. talent_builds.stat_summary: Rabbia extra sotto il 30% di truppe, poi statistiche fanteria.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash: albero Defense per primo, arrivare a Desperate Elegy il prima possibile (nei rally e' normale avere l'esercito ridotto); poi Infantry per statistiche e rabbia. RKG: 'ottimo per AOO e KVK dove si rallano molti obiettivi', flessibile anche in campo.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Salute, difesa, generazione rabbia.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash: Defense senza Desperate Elegy, piu' punti Infantry, Buckler Shield per ridurre il danno da contrattacco. RKG: 'Field build' su salute, difesa e rabbia.

pairings.note: AllClash: 'sostegno incredibile e ottimo danno'; si puo' scambiare in positivo anche quando si viene swarmati. [rokstats: pairing ufficiale in gioco 'Pakal Conquest', questo comandante primario]
AllClash: entrambi usabili da primario; manca AoE. RKG: 'coppia discreta in campo ma non buona per rally'.
RKG: Guan Yu primario (danno), Pakal sopravvivenza e anti-swarm. AllClash: valida ma piu' debole.

commanders.recommended_equipment: AllClash - Starter: Helm of Phoenix, Infantry Breastplate, Blessed Blade. Advanced: Witch's Lineage, Hope Cloak, Gatekeeper's Shield. commanders.notes: Fanteria da rally/conquista introdotta con l'update 'March of the Ages' (RKG). Danno single-target ma ottimo contro lo swarm grazie alla riduzione danni per nemico circostante (AllClash). Civilta' 'Mayan' secondo AllClash.
